name: Project Gutenberg: Spanish books
note: Public-domain books. Open one, choose “Plain Text UTF-8”, copy it, and paste it under Add text. (A web page cannot fetch these for you.)

name: ManyThings: sentence pairs with audio
note: The same Tatoeba sentences Margen already uses for practice sets, as downloads for flashcard apps.

name: Tatoeba
note: Add your own sentences or listen to recordings for many of them. CC BY 2.0 FR.

name: StoryWeaver
note: Illustrated children’s stories by reading level, CC BY 4.0. Its data feed does not include story text, so read these on the site.

name: Free Kids Books
note: Children’s books to read or download, with a Spanish section. Licences differ per book.

name: Instituto Cervantes: Lecturas paso a paso
note: Official graded readings (inicial, intermedio, avanzado). Copyrighted, for your own study.

name: Lingua.com
note: Free reading texts from A1 to B2 on a commercial site.

name: Bilinguis and Alba Learning
note: Classic stories with Spanish and English side by side. Search for them by name. Licences not checked.
